findings.title: No audit trail for auditor private-session reads
findings.problem: The auditor can now read every user's private Personal sessions via /sessions and session detail, but only the denial path (access_denied_cli_analytics) logs; successful privileged reads leave no record.
findings.impact: No documented rule requires it and the read is read-only by PO decision; the consequence is reduced traceability of a privacy exception, not a functional defect.
findings.recommendation: Question: is an access log for auditor reads of other users' private sessions wanted? If so, log actor id and trace_id on the auditor branch.
